entities.name: PMID:27499609
observations: Yang et al. studied TF-driven VEGF expression and Wnt/β-catenin signaling in CoCl2-treated human ARPE-19 cells.

TF overexpression increased VEGF and TF silencing decreased VEGF; Wnt inhibitor IWR-1-endo attenuated the TF-overexpression effects, supporting Wnt/β-catenin involvement but not definitive pathway-specific mediation.
